headline: Sequoia shuts down its scout program
script: Sequoia this week announced a broad overhaul, including closing its London office and shutting down its scout program. A scout is a founder or operator who writes checks on the firm's behalf. Sequoia pioneered this model seventeen years ago. Many venture capital firms followed, competing harder for deal flow. But a consensus is emerging that the model has reached its limits. Not everyone was convinced in the first place. One investor said the scouts themselves do not care much about the investments. Sequoia framed the decision as part of a need for more focus. Its goal is putting more energy behind fewer people and things. Rival firm Andreessen Horowitz has also revamped its scout network. Under the new approach, scouts get more resources but are expected to be more active. For founders, being a scout can be a stepping stone to a partner role. One former scout said she was sad and hoped other funds would not follow suit.

sentences.text: Sequoia this week announced a broad overhaul, including closing its London office and shutting down its scout program.
sentences.zh: 红杉资本本周宣布了一项大规模改革，包括关闭其伦敦办公室并终止其侦察员项目。
sentences.focus: closing its — link the s to its

sentences.text: A scout is a founder or operator who writes checks on the firm's behalf.
sentences.zh: 侦察员是指代表公司开出支票的创始人或运营者。

sentences.text: Sequoia pioneered this model seventeen years ago.
sentences.zh: 红杉在十七年前开创了这一模式。

sentences.text: Many venture capital firms followed, competing harder for deal flow.
sentences.zh: 许多风险投资公司纷纷效仿，为争夺项目来源竞争更激烈。

sentences.text: But a consensus is emerging that the model has reached its limits.
sentences.zh: 但一种共识正在形成：该模式已达到其极限。
sentences.focus: reached its — link the d to its

sentences.text: Not everyone was convinced in the first place.
sentences.zh: 并不是所有人都一开始就信服。

sentences.text: One investor said the scouts themselves do not care much about the investments.
sentences.zh: 一位投资者说，侦察员本身并不太关心这些投资。

sentences.text: Sequoia framed the decision as part of a need for more focus.
sentences.zh: 红杉将这一决定描述为需要更专注的一部分。

sentences.text: Its goal is putting more energy behind fewer people and things.
sentences.zh: 其目标是把更多精力放在更少的人和事上。

sentences.text: Rival firm Andreessen Horowitz has also revamped its scout network.
sentences.zh: 竞争对手安德森·霍洛维茨也改革了其侦察员网络。

sentences.text: Under the new approach, scouts get more resources but are expected to be more active.
sentences.zh: 在新方法下，侦察员获得更多资源，但也被期望更加活跃。

sentences.text: For founders, being a scout can be a stepping stone to a partner role.
sentences.zh: 对创始人来说，当侦察员可以成为通往合伙人角色的垫脚石。

sentences.text: One former scout said she was sad and hoped other funds would not follow suit.
sentences.zh: 一位前侦察员说，她感到难过，并希望其他基金不要效仿。

terms.note: 指代表投资公司寻找项目并开出小额支票的创始人或运营者。
指投资公司能接触到的潜在投资项目数量。
指向初创公司投资以换取股权的资金。
指帮助人达到更高目标的过渡阶段。

grammar.point: 定语从句 who writes checks
grammar.note: who 引导定语从句修饰 founder or operator，中文习惯把修饰语放在名词前，容易漏掉 who。
强调到目前为止的结果，中文常说“已经”而容易漏掉 has。

grammar.point: 被动语态 are expected to
grammar.note: 表示被期望做某事，中文习惯用主动说法，容易漏掉 are。

questions.q: What did Sequoia announce this week?
options: Closing its London office and ending scouts
questions.explain: 答案在第一句，提到关闭伦敦办公室并终止侦察员项目。

questions.q: How did Andreessen Horowitz change its scout program?
options: It gave scouts more resources but expected them to be more active
questions.explain: 答案在第十一句，提到侦察员获得更多资源但被期望更活跃。
